That's why I took the job.''"
"''This appeals to you? This doesn't appeal to me, and I live here.|Asajj Ventress and Cort||audio=DoesntAppealToMe.mp3}} '''Cort''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who lived in a [[Unidentified desert town|desert town]] on an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Cort)|astronomical object]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], she hired [[Asajj Ventress]], the former lead [[assassin]] of [[Count]] [[Dooku]], to kick out uncompliant customers from her [[Cort's transport office|transport office]]. Their cooperation ended abruptly when Ventress stood up for [[Lyco Strata]], a young [[Jedi]] escaping the [[Great Jedi Purge]] whom Cort had given away to a [[stormtrooper]] patrol in hopes of earning a substantial reward. ==Biography== ===Routine at the office=== {{Quote|No ticket, no ride.''"
"''I don't have any money.''"
"''No money, no ticket.''"
[takes out a blaster] "''I need to get out of here.''"
"''Your problems are not my problems.|Cort and a customer||audio=YourProblems.mp3}} [[File:Cort_at_gunpoint.png|thumb|right|250px|A Rodian customer threatens Cort with a blaster.]] During the [[Imperial Era]], a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] named Cort lived in a [[Unidentified desert town|desert town]] on an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Cort)|astronomical object]] and worked as a clerk in a [[Cort's transport office|transport office]]. At some point, she employed [[Asajj Ventress]], the former lead [[assassin]] of [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. While Ventress stood at the entrance scanning customers' cards, Cort sat at a nearby counter and served those that Ventress allowed to pass. Ventress also handled uncooperative customers, removing them from the office when necessary. One [[Standard day|day]], as office customers lined up for check-in, Ventress granted passage to a [[Unidentified Rodian transport office customer|Rodian]], who walked up to the counter. The individual attempted to persuade Cort to give him a ticket free-of-charge, insisting that he had no [[Currency|money]]. When she refused, the individual drew a [[blaster pistol]], claiming he desperately needed to get out of town. Before he could fire a shot, Ventress disarmed the [[Rodian]] and tossed him out of the office. Meanwhile, Cort reminded Ventress that she paid her to remove people—not [[Death|kill]] them—which she believed would make for a poor business strategy. She then praised Ventress for her skills and suggested they branch out and start a business of their own. Ventress, however, declined, admitting that she enjoyed the peaceful life her current job provided. After Ventress exited through the blast door, Cort muttered to herself that the peace and quiet did not appeal to her, as it did to Ventress, even though she was the one who lived there. ===The Lyco Strata incident=== {{Quote|If you see anything, report it. There's a substantial reward.''"
"''Reward? Wait. They're back here.|A stormtrooper and Cort, the latter giving away Lyco Stata's hiding place||audio=TheyreBackHere.mp3}} [[File:Skirmish_in_the_office.png|thumb|left|250px|Ventress deflects stormtroopers' blaster fire after Cort has given away Lyco Strata.]] After Ventress left the establishment, Cort returned to the seat behind the counter and soon tended to a [[human]] boy named [[Lyco Strata]].{{TOTU|Friends}} Unbeknownst to the woman, the boy was a former member of the [[Jedi Order]] who had survived [[Order 66]] and was ''en route'' to the [[Hidden Path]], an underground network that sheltered [[Great Purge]] survivors from the [[Galactic Empire]]. When Lyco's credits proved insufficient to purchase a ticket, they attempted to [[Mind trick|mind-trick]] Cort into accepting the payment regardless. However, the woman remained immune to their machinations. Shortly afterward, Ventress re-entered and sided with her co-worker, escorting the boy to the door only to quickly shut it again upon spotting a [[stormtrooper]] group grouped gathered outside. Ventress pulled Lyco back in and instructed them take cover behind Cort's counter. Cort, in turn, asked whether the boy was in trouble, but the Dathomirian dismissed her concerned and told her to keep quiet. Once a total of five stormtroopers entered the office in the company of a [[Viper probe droid]] floating in the [[Atmosphere|air]], Cort was asked for her credential and started patting her pockets. Ventress, however, successfully used a mind trick to convince them that nothing was amiss and that no one had entered the building that day. She additionally redirected them to docking bay 24. As the patrol was about to leave, one of the stormtroopers reminded Ventress and Cort to report any suspicious activity, noting there was a substantial reward. In response, Cort suddenly told them to wait and revealed that Lyco was hiding behind the counter. In defense, Ventress and Lyco ignited their [[lightsaber]]s and deflect the stormtroopers' [[blaster]] fire, killing the soldiers but sparing Cort, who had been cowering throughout the skirmish. When the dust settled, she opened her [[eye]]s to find the bodies of the troopers scattered across the office. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Well, you got some skill. I'll give you that. Maybe we should be branching out. Make some real money.''"
"''I don't want that life anymore.|Cort suggests she and Ventress branch out||audio=BranchingOut.mp3}} [[File:Business_matters.png|thumb|right|250px|Ventress and Cort discuss business matters.]] Cort was a human female with [[Color|light]] skin and green eyes. She wore her dark [[hair]] slicked back and gathered in a short style at the back. Working as a clerk at a transport office, Cort grew bored with her career path and place of abode. In pursuit of money, she toyed with the idea of branching out and starting her own business with Asajj Ventress. ==Equipment== When she worked as a transport office clerk, Cort sported a dark-olive utilitarian uniform with chest pockets and a green garment underneath. In addition, she adorned her [[ear]]s with a pair of [[Piercing|earrings]]. ==Behind the scenes== Cort debuted in the first episode of the 3D CGI animation series, ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]''—"[[A Way Forward]]," where she was voiced by the actress [[Tudi Roche]]. The episode premiered on [[May 4]], [[2025]], on [[Disney+]],{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} with a pre-release [[May 2|two days earlier]] in the video game ''[[Fortnite]]''.{{Fortnite|url=news/get-a-new-stormtrooper-in-fortnite-and-watch-two-episodes-of-star-wars-tales-of-the-underworld|text=Get a New Stormtrooper in Fortnite & Watch Two Episodes of Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld!}} ==Appearances== *{{TOTU|A Way Forward}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Cort |ka=კორტი (ადამიანი) }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
